overview: Redesign of the SocialSMS World dashboard and all feature sections (virtual numbers, airtime, data, TV, fund wallet, history, profile, etc.) into a modern, sleek black-and-white (monochrome dark-first) color scheme while preserving the exact layout structure, navigation items, cards, and functionality.

rules: No colored accents (green, emerald, purple) in main UI cards, buttons, or background gradients.
Strict monochrome palette: Pure black (#000000), deep zinc/obsidian (#0A0A0A, #121212), dark zinc borders (#262626), clean white typography (#FFFFFF), and zinc grays (#A1A1AA) for secondary text.
Primary actions (e.g., Fund Wallet, Buy Number, Submit) use solid white background with black text (`bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200`) or stark outline borders.
Hover states must always explicitly set text color (e.g., `hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white`).
NO transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, floating headers, or popovers—use solid dark backgrounds with 1px zinc borders (`bg-zinc-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-zinc-800`).

fonts.headings: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, or system-ui sans-serif
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace for transaction IDs, phone numbers, and API keys

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white
scale.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-500 font-mono

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #262626 (zinc-800) with rounded-xl or rounded-2xl radii for modern tactile feel
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle dark ambient shadows (`shadow-2xl shadow-black/80`) and high-contrast 1px inner glows (`border border-white/10`)
visual_enhancers.cards: Dark obsidian surface (`bg-zinc-900` / `bg-black`) with subtle 1px border (`border-zinc-800`), sleek hover transition with border light-up (`hover:border-zinc-600`)
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for floating top header and sticky top bar: `bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-800`

sections: BUY NUMBERS (Usa Numbers, Other Usa Numbers, All Country Numbers, More Country Numbers)
BOTTOM NAVIGATION (My Profile, Site Tour, Logout)

header.background: bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-zinc-800 z-40 sticky top-0
components: Wallet Balance Pill (`bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 text-white font-mono px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full`)
Notification Bell Dropdown with Dark Theme Popover

instructions_to_main_agent: Re-skin all dashboard views, server selection cards, bill payment forms, virtual cards, travel, and fund wallet components to adhere to the strict Black and White color system.

Replace all existing emerald, green, purple, and color gradient classes (e.g. `bg-emerald-500`, `text-purple-600`, `from-emerald-600 to-teal-700`) with high-contrast monochrome classes (`bg-white`, `text-white`, `bg-zinc-900`, `border-zinc-800`, `bg-black`).
Ensure every interactive button, input field, table row, tab button, dropdown item, and card has explicit `data-testid` attributes.
Maintain all existing API calls, wallet balance logic, SSE real-time updates, SMS verification triggers, and form state logic.
All dropdowns and dialog popovers MUST have opaque dark backgrounds (`bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 text-white`) and never transparent backgrounds.
Update `src/index.css` CSS variables or theme classes so dark mode is forced or default with pure black `#000000` background.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure text visibility meets APCA contrast standards. High contrast black & white is essential.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds in popovers, dropdowns, headers, or overlays.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming.
Always explicitly define text color on hover and focus states.
Rotate through clean, distinct font choices without defaulting to Inter for headings.
Use 2-3x generous spacing with Tailwind padding and gaps.
All React code uses `.js` or `.jsx` file extension in this repository.
